title: Exact cubic unit relation authority
objective: Determine and verify whether reconstructed real-cubic units are exactly the algebraic products generated by retained accepted relations, or identify the exact missing source mapping.

handoff.summary: The isolated unit lane retains a 2x7 accepted-factor provenance matrix but no direct 73x7 raw-relation map. The presentation authority can reconstruct that missing map as its replayed 73x73 sparse transform restricted to 15 active columns times the first seven kernel columns of the 15x15 HNF transform. This lane adds an exact rational cubic verifier which composes such a map with the 73 retained principal generators and requires coordinate equality with both reconstructed units.
risks: The focused checker exercises the verifier against the explicitly answer-derived replay factor pool, not the genuine 73 relations; genuine evidence must be supplied by the detached presentation authority.
Only totally real cubic coordinate arithmetic is implemented.
next_steps: Pass the presentation authority's detached 73x7 map and retained alpha coordinates into verify_cubic_relation_units.
Bind the verified map, exact unit coordinates, and both authority hashes into final state.
